CheckTitle: Ensure IAM password policy prevents password reuse
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks that the account password policy prevents reuse of the last 24 passwords.
Risk: Allowing password reuse lets previously compromised passwords become valid again.

Recommendation.Text: Set the password policy to remember 24 previous passwords.
